title: Ok, but my other older ones are sharper! The  knife part has a cover .
text:
Ok, but my other older ones are sharper! The knife part has a cover .. A nice modern looking chopper-mezzaluna.
The handle seems like a type of silicone, rubbery, and easy on the hand.
Says you can put it in the dishwasher, but if you want it to last longer, Don’t..
Dishwasher also dull knifes.

It chopped ok, but haven’t had a chance to try it on homemade pizza to cut it, as that might be the judge on how sharp this is!

I have used Ulu’s to chop, which are sharper then this KitchenAid,but not as wide etc.
And my Grandmother’s chopper that is deeper then this But not quite as long. Although it is over
a 100 years old, and about as sharp as this KitchenAid is, or sharper!
The KitchenAid does come with a cover that is a good safety feature. Although the Ulu comes with a wooden block it sits in.
And Grandmas goes on my long magnetic knife bar on my kitchen wall.

For me this is a 3 star.
